subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Shelf Life Realities
description: A quick win: understand Shelf Life Realities.

hook.text: Roasted coffee doesn't expire like milk, but it does peak quickly and decline slowly.

buildup.text: Peak flavor hits 5–14 days after roasting. After three weeks, noticeable staling begins.

discovery.text: Green (unroasted) beans, however, can last 6–12 months if stored in cool, dry, dark conditions.

twist.text: Supermarket beans are often months old by the time you buy them. The roast date is rarely printed.

climax.text: Specialty roasters print roast dates. Buying within two weeks of roasting ensures peak quality.

punchline.text: Check the roast date. Freshness has a short, sweet window.
